text:
Priya (Sales): Kicking off POC with MeridianBank tomorrow. Main asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain ownership proof. Need owners + blockers.
Devon (SE): I can own SAML/SCIM integration. Quick Q — will they be IdP-initiated or SP-initiated?
Priya (Sales): They prefer IdP-initiated via Okta, but asked for both flows.
Devon (SE): OK. We'll need SP metadata (ACS + EntityID). I'll send a staging metadata blob.
Devon (SE): Example SP XML we will provide to them: <EntityDescriptor entityID="https://staging.redwood.ai/sp/meridian">...<AssertionConsumerService Location="https://staging.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>...</EntityDescriptor>
Evan (Solutions): For SCIM they asked about delta sync + bulk import. We support SCIM 2.0 full + incremental PATCH. Example patch for role assign: {
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"add","path":"roles","value": ["app_admin"]}]
}
Matt (SRE): FYI for private/dedicated POC: networking will require IP allowlist or VPC peering. Which one does Meridian want?
Priya (Sales): They asked for VPC peering (compliance reason). Can SRE own peering setup for the POC?
Matt (SRE): I can. Need their AWS account ID and CIDR ranges by EOD.
Sarah (Security): Security checklist for procurement: SOC2 report, encryption at rest & in transit, KMS integration (customer-managed option), audit log retention window, and support for SCIM deprovisioning. Also confirm we store SCIM tokens encrypted.
Devon (SE): We do encrypt SCIM tokens with KMS. We also log provisioning actions to audit logs (sha256 user ids).
Legal (Bot): Reminder: customer asked for DPA and incident notification SLA. Sales: please capture contact for legal review.
Priya (Sales): Filed legal contact: legal@meridianbank.com. I'll attach to the ticket.
Evan (Solutions): RBAC mapping question: Meridian has 4 roles (SuperAdmin, Admin, Manager, ReadOnly). Suggest mapping to app roles: super_admin -> app_admin, admin -> app_config, manager -> app_user, readonly -> app_viewer. Does that match?
Matt (SRE): That mapping looks fine. Note: if they want role inheritance we need explicit rules — we don't currently do transitive RBAC out of the box.
Devon (SE): For SAML sessions — default session duration is 8 hours in hosted flows; can shorten via assertion/session timeout config. Meridian asked for 1 hour. We can support that on SP side.
Priya (Sales): Pricing question from procurement: POC expected ~200k tokens/day, 5 concurrent sessions. They asked for estimate hosted vs reserved capacity for 30-day POC.
Devon (SE): Quick guidance: hosted API estimate ~$X/day (usage), reserved monthly min is higher but gives latency SLAs. I'll ping finance for an exact quote.
Priya (Sales): Can someone draft an official POC quote we can send today?
Evan (Solutions): I can draft a one-page that includes functional scope, networking, security checklist, and pricing ranges.
Sarah (Security): Also add penetration test requirement (they may request attestation) and support for JWE-wrapped SAML assertions if they mandate.
Matt (SRE): deploy-bot: provisioning env created: staging-meridian-2026. (deployment id: d-8732)
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging cluster up, SP metadata endpoint: https://staging.redwood.ai/metadata/meridian
Devon (SE): I'll generate demo SSO configs and a test Okta org link. Evan, can you create test users with roles?
Evan (Solutions): Yep — will provision 3 test users this morning and share creds in 1Password.
Priya (Sales): Timeline check — goal: end-to-end SSO+SCIM+RBAC demo by Wed. Owners: Devon (integration), Matt (network), Evan (test users), Sarah (security sign-off), Priya (customer coordination).
Priya (Sales): Linking runbook & tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521 — please add comments with blockers.
Devon (SE): Noted. I'll add the SAML metadata and SCIM spec examples to the ticket.
Matt (SRE): I'll request their AWS account info in the ticket and start peering request once received.
Sarah (Security): I'll prepare the short security attestation doc for procurement.
Priya (Sales): Awesome — thanks everyone. Ping me if anything blocks the Wed demo. :thumbsup:
